recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit for FHIR-36683. If FHIR-26062 is reconciled later, separately assess its broader request for CodeSystem modifier-type properties rather than treating this seed audit as deciding that issue.
issue_request: FHIR-36683 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for R5 asking that search-modifier-code and the matching ValueSet use of-type instead of the inconsistent ofType spelling.
initial_application: Commit 7c3f73fb1f51cbbb40b332c19799a40dbab2bfaf explicitly says Apply FHIR-36683 and changed source/searchparameter/codesystem-search-modifier-code.xml from ofType to of-type. A later QA cleanup removed generated CodeSystem narrative but retained the of-type concept code.
additional_context: FHIR Infrastructure minutes for 2022-04-04 record the same decision and vote. FHIR-26062 is an older same-change-family issue with the same spelling correction plus an additional CodeSystem-properties request, and FHIR-36684 was applied in the same source commit but already has its own combined-branch reconciliation commit.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because source/fhir.ini keeps SearchParameter and search-modifier-code in build scope, source/searchparameter/codesystem-search-modifier-code.xml now contains code value of-type, and source/search.html consistently documents of-type.

related_jiras.note: Older Published issue requested the same ofType to of-type correction and also included a broader CodeSystem-properties request not decided here.
